verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.ramp.com (HTTP 200). It is a machine-readable index with explicit agent usage instructions, per-guide plain-text exports, llms-api.txt and llms-full.txt bundles, and channel-selection recommendations for agents. Further probes confirm the linked OpenAPI schema and a working unauthenticated Developer docs MCP server, so the agent-oriented docs surface is both documented and hands-on verified.
